entities.name: Demetrios Doukas Komnenos Koutroules

entities.summary: Demetrios, later renamed Michael, Doukas Komnenos Koutroules Angelos was the third son of the ruler of Epirus, Michael II Komnenos Doukas, also surnamed Koutroules, and his wife Theodora of Arta.
